name: power-automate-mcp-server
description: Inspect, operate, and author Microsoft Power Automate cloud flows from Claude Desktop.
long_description:
Power Automate MCP Server lets you manage Microsoft Power Automate cloud flows directly from Claude Desktop — and lightly author them too.

**Read / debug (always on):**
- List environments, flows, and connections (with broken-connection detection)
- Inspect a flow's full definition (triggers, actions, connection references)
- List and drill into runs — status, timing, first-failure detail
- List flow owners

**Operate & author (enable write ops):**
- Enable / disable flows
- Cancel / resubmit runs
- Add / remove owners
- Create / update / delete flows (programmatic authoring)

**How it works:**
- Per-user **device-code sign-in** that surfaces the code right in the chat — no terminal.
- Targets the `api.flow.microsoft.com` management surface (sees personal "My Flows"; no Premium license needed).
- Read-only by default; mutating tools are gated behind a single setting, and delete requires explicit confirmation.

**Setup:** you supply your own Azure app registration (multi-tenant public client with the Microsoft Flow Service delegated permission and public-client flows enabled) — see the README.

tools.name: list_flows
tools.description: List cloud flows in an environment

tools.name: list_flow_runs
tools.description: List recent runs of a flow

tools.name: get_flow_run
tools.description: Get one run in detail for debugging

tools.name: add_flow_owner
tools.description: Grant a principal a role on a flow (write-gated)

tools.name: report_feedback
tools.description: Report a bug or API drift to the maintainers

azure_client_id.title: Azure Client ID
azure_client_id.description: Application (client) ID of your Entra app registration (multi-tenant public client). Required.

azure_tenant_id.title: Azure Tenant ID
azure_tenant_id.description: Your tenant GUID. Required — 'common' fails for the Flow audience (AADSTS50059).

flow_scopes.title: Flow Scopes
flow_scopes.description: Comma-separated OAuth scopes. Default works for most setups; use specific scopes when reusing a shared app.

enable_write_ops.title: Enable write operations
enable_write_ops.description: Allow mutating tools (enable/disable, cancel/resubmit, owners, create/update/delete flow). Off = read-only.

default_environment.title: Default environment id
default_environment.description: If set, tools without an explicit environment use this instead of discovering the default.

azure_auth_mode.title: Auth mode
azure_auth_mode.description: 'interactive' (device-code, default) or 'clientCredentials' (app-only, needs a client secret).

azure_client_secret.title: Azure Client Secret
azure_client_secret.description: Only for clientCredentials mode (app-only). Leave blank for interactive device-code.
